```yaml
name: Draft Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      new_version:
        description: 'New version to release (e.g., 1.2.3)'
        required: false
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model abbreviation (codex, glm, kimi)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  draft:
    if: github.actor == 'dyoshikawa' || github.actor == 'cm-dyoshikawa'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Resolve model abbreviation
        id: model
        uses: ./.github/actions/select-opencode-model
        with:
          input-text: ${{ github.event.inputs.model }}

      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [[ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}" ]]; then
            echo "version=${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            # Run release-dry-run script to get the next version
            npx ts-node scripts/release-dry-run.ts --dry-run > next_version.txt
            NEXT_VERSION=$(cat next_version.txt)
            echo "version=$NEXT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Install GitHub CLI
        uses: cli/cli@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create release branch
        run: |
          git checkout -b release/v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          git push origin release/v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}

      - name: Create pull request
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const version = process.env.VERSION;
            const { data: pr } = await github.pulls.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: `Release v${version}`,
              head: `release/v${version}`,
              base: 'main',
              body: 'Automated release PR'
            });
            console.log('PR created:', pr.html_url);
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}

      - name: Create draft release
        run: |
          gh release create v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }} \
            --draft \
            --title "v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" \
            --notes "Draft release for v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
